dialogue.speaker: Static Voice
dialogue.text: You're already dead, friend. The Butcher and the Strategist buried you—yet the pact drags you back.

dialogue.speaker: The Strategist
dialogue.text: You think dying was an accident? Look at the rift...

dialogue.speaker: The Betrayer
dialogue.text: I sealed the pact so neither of us could leave. Forgive me—or end me.
